ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-15-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name and Gender.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Kathy Kollehner.
Lisa Raney, Esq. for Petitioner: Nathaniel Yongsu Chung, present, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: -----------------
Pending the filing of Medical Certificate under penalty of perjury.
The Court further orders the gender of --------------- is changed from Female to Male.

Decree to be signed.
